name: Retia Adolf
original_name: レーティア・アドルフ
source:
Fuhrer and Idol of the Dokutsu Third Reich.

The Greatest Genius of the World—she dramatically revolutionized the Dokutsu Third Reich's politics, economics, inventions, and military. On the other hand, she pays no regard to fashion and social life, which makes Goebbels a figure in polishing her current status of an Idol.

    “Luck? Are you kidding me? War never depends on something like that.” 

[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Retia_Adolf]Alicesoftwiki's review[/url].]
